fields.climate: tropical; moderated by trade winds; dry season (November to April); rainy season (May to October)
fields.terrain: mostly flat to rolling plains, with rugged hills and mountains in the southeast
fields.hazards: the east coast is subject to hurricanes from August to November (in general, the country averages about one hurricane every other year); droughts are common
fields.resources: cobalt, nickel, iron ore, chromium, copper, salt, timber, silica, petroleum, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, cassava, plantains, vegetables, mangoes/guavas, milk, tomatoes, pumpkins/squash, sweet potatoes, bananas
fields.exports: tobacco, nickel, liquor, zinc ore, precious metal ore
fields.industries: petroleum, nickel, cobalt, pharmaceuticals, tobacco, construction, steel, cement, agricultural machinery, sugar
fields.religions: Christian 58.9%, folk religion 17.6%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, Muslim <1%, other <1%, none 23.2%
fields.legal: civil law system based on Spanish civil code
fields.military: military service is mandatory for all men and voluntary for women (ages 17-28); service obligation is 24 months with the Armed Forces or the Ministry of Interior…
